A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have made a significant contribution to the experimental study of beta-decay spectroscopy of nuclei near the proton drip-line.
our experimental data have provided important information to the nuclear structure of the rare-earth region and to the astrophysical rp process.

the experimental study on beta-delayed proton decaying nuclides near the proton drip-line has made significant contributions to the understanding of the astrophysical rapid proton capture (rp) process, the nuclear shell structure, and the production-reaction mechanism.

the {beta}-delay proton decays are important for nuclear astrophysics and nuclear structure studies.
